mapper.select: select id, member_id as memberId, level_no as levelNo, exp_value as expValue, last_active_time as lastActiveTime, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime from member_growth where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into member_growth (member_id, level_no, exp_value, last_active_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{levelNo}, #{expValue}, #{lastActiveTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update update_time = values(update_time)
